_comment: H-CLU-001: Same URL or lightly modified title candidates should merge into one story cluster, but multi-source evidence from each duplicate should be preserved as distinct evidence chunks.
description: Two candidates about the same Zelda movie announcement — one from IGN (original report), one from a Chinese gaming site (repost with slightly different title). They share a canonical URL and similar normalized title, so they should merge into a single story_cluster. However, each candidate brings its own fetched document evidence that must be preserved for downstream claim verification.

candidate.title: The Legend of Zelda live-action movie officially confirmed by Nintendo
candidate.snippet: Nintendo has officially confirmed a live-action Legend of Zelda movie is in development with Sony Pictures, directed by Wes Ball.

evidence.quote: Nintendo announced today that a live-action Legend of Zelda film is in production with Sony Pictures. Director Wes Ball (The Maze Runner trilogy) is attached to helm the project.
Shigeru Miyamoto will serve as producer alongside Avi Arad. The film is currently in early pre-production with no release date set.

candidate.title: 任天堂正式确认《塞尔达传说》真人电影正在制作中
candidate.snippet: 任天堂官方确认《塞尔达传说》真人电影项目，由索尼影业联合制作，韦斯·鲍尔执导。此消息源自IGN报道。
candidate.query: 塞尔达传说 真人电影 任天堂 确认

evidence.quote: 任天堂今日正式宣布，《塞尔达传说》真人电影项目已进入前期制作阶段，由索尼影业联合制作，导演韦斯·鲍尔将执导本片。宫本茂将担任制片人之一。
目前官方尚未公布上映日期，但业界分析认为该片有望在2028年上映。此消息最早由IGN报道。

verification_notes.merge_correct: Both candidates share substantially the same normalized title and report the same event. They SHOULD merge into a single story cluster.
verification_notes.evidence_preserved: Each candidate retains its original evidence array. The IGN evidence provides the official English-language quotes; the Gamersky evidence provides the Chinese-language coverage and industry analyst commentary. Both evidence sources are accessible for downstream claim verification.
verification_notes.multi_source_benefit: The merged cluster has 2 distinct source URLs, which improves the credibility scoring in story_ranking (source_count bonus).
